claim.quote: We review the main results obtained by the BRAHMS collaboration on the properties of hot and dense hadronic and partonic matter produced in ultrarelativistic heavy ion collisions at RHIC.

name: BRAHMS white paper: QGP and CGC at RHIC
notes: A review/white paper recorded as a measurement result, never a discovery; the abstract poses the QGP evidence as a question.

summary.plain: BRAHMS's 2005 review of its main results on hot, dense matter in gold-gold collisions at RHIC, discussing how far the results (together with the other three experiments) can be taken as evidence of a deconfined quark-gluon plasma and of a precursor state, the colour glass condensate.
summary.technical: Review of the main BRAHMS results on hot and dense hadronic and partonic matter in ultrarelativistic heavy-ion collisions at RHIC, assessing the evidence for a deconfined quark-gluon plasma and for a possible precursor, the Color Glass Condensate.

title: Quark Gluon Plasma and Color Glass Condensate at RHIC? The perspective from the BRAHMS experiment
why_it_matters: One of the four 2005 RHIC white papers in which each experiment assessed what its data show about the matter created at RHIC.
